Roles are product, brand, attribute, or unclassified. For product, brand, and unclassified, kind must be empty. Use attribute kinds according to the meaning of the source text. For one item, keep exactly one core product segment. Do not split the core product identity into multiple product segments. Separate clear product properties into attributes. Attribute kinds may repeat when they represent distinct properties. Segment text must be copied exactly from the source. Segments must not overlap.
